8aeb0048:  .;
 .;Initialize deficiency tracking for admissions with certain
 .;characteristics. The characteristics are:
 .;an admission within the past 2 days which has a
 .;Movement Admission Type of "Standard Admission".
 .;and
 .;an admission from the previous day which has a
 .;Movement Admission Type of "Standard Admission".
b916cdc2: ;Initialize variables.
fe2a2da0: ;Determine today's date.
1caac3f9: ;If unable to determine today's date, quit.

4aced4c7: ;Task creation. If successful, display the task number.
edd3d9f7: ;Done with initialization, quit to task.

acff3282:  .;
 .;Initiate process for two date ranges:
 .;1) Admissions from 2 days ago until today at 23:59
 .;2) Admissions from yesterday until today at 23:59
748595b7: ;Calculate the date 2 days ago.
4e7be9df: ;Initialize flags to indicate no processing done yet.
308007f8: ;Set the date range for 2 days ago until today at 23:59. Initiate short processing for this date range.
6a421bec: ;Calculate yesterday's date.
ea92706a: ;Set the date range for yesterday until today at 23:59. Initiate main processing for this date range.
4eb18476: ;Done with process for date ranges, quit.
47029c72: ;Initialize counters and admission entry values for short processing.

208340f9:  .;Loop through admissions in the date range. Process each admission
 .;that meets the following criteria:
 .;- Movement Admission Type is "Standard Admission"
 .;- Admission Movement Date/Time is within the date range
 .;- The admission is open (not discharged).
 .;For each matching admission, do the SET and CK routines.
6ca2b90f: ;Done with short processing, quit.

fa2cf4bd:  .;Check if the admission date is within 2 days of the discharge date.
 .;If so, initiate the SETUP routine and set a flag indicating action is required.
 .;The SETUP routine likely initiates deficiency tracking for the admission.
49e40399: ;Done with CK routine, quit.
